items.html: And this is their matter. Know that this surrounding light of the sixth aspect resembles the surrounding light of the fourth aspect. For that surrounding light surrounds opposite the NHY of Ima, within which the Mochin of ZA are clothed within; and it is above the head of ZA, surrounding his entire head and skull and all the inner Mochin within it. But this surrounding light of the sixth aspect goes out from the illumination of the inner Mochin within the head itself of ZA; and if it goes out from the Mochin and is inferior to them, how can it surround them in the aspect of surrounding light, which is greater than the inner light? Therefore it does not surround except the aspect of the face of ZA alone, and it goes out from the forehead, between the eyes, and from there it stands and surrounds the face beneath the eyes; and they are the aspect of Tefillin literally. And this is what is said in Idra de Haazinu, page 292: "And his face shone, and he testified in Aba and Ima," etc. And this is the secret of "And they shall be for frontlets between your eyes."
